executive_summary_zh: 今天候选内容整体信号较弱，缺少与 AI 编码代理、评测基准、harness 设计、MCP 或开发者工作流深度相关的原创技术内容。
仅有的更新集中在 GitHub 安全能力的小幅改进：新增 Cloudflare service token 的 secret scanning 检测，以及公共监控告警支持直接深链分享。
对平台与工程负责人而言，这些内容更适合纳入日常安全运维跟踪，而非完整情报摘要的核心条目。
executive_summary_en: Overall signal is weak today, with no strong original technical content on AI coding agents, evals, harness design, MCP, or deep developer workflow changes.
The only notable updates are small GitHub security improvements: secret scanning support for Cloudflare service tokens and direct-linking for public monitoring alerts.
For backend/platform/engineering leads, these are better treated as routine security operations updates rather than core digest items.

items.title: Secret scanning detects Cloudflare service tokens - GitHub Changelog
items.summary_zh: GitHub Secret Scanning 新增对 Cloudflare service token 的检测器，可在仓库中识别 `cloudflare_access_service_token`。公开仓库中的合作伙伴密钥会通过 partner program 自动上报给提供方，用户密钥则在公开或私有仓库中触发告警。
items.summary_en: GitHub Secret Scanning now detects Cloudflare service tokens, specifically `cloudflare_access_service_token`, in repositories. Partner secrets found in public repos are automatically reported to the issuer, while user secrets generate alerts in public or private repos.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是一个低层级但实用的供应链与凭据防护增强。若团队在 AI 辅助编码、自动化脚本或基础设施仓库中频繁生成和提交 Cloudflare 相关配置，此检测器可降低凭据意外泄露的暴露窗口。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a low-level but practical supply-chain and credential protection improvement. For teams using AI-assisted coding, automation scripts, or infra repos that touch Cloudflare configs, the detector reduces exposure from accidentally committed tokens.
key_takeaways_zh: 公开仓库中的 partner secret 可自动通知提供方；私有与公开仓库中的用户密钥可触发告警。
key_takeaways_en: Public partner-secret matches can be auto-reported to the provider; user secrets trigger alerts in both public and private repos.

items.title: Public monitoring alerts now have direct links - GitHub Changelog
items.summary_zh: GitHub 企业版的 Public Monitoring 告警现支持直接链接到单条告警。用户可在企业的 Public monitoring 视图中点击告警编号打开详情，并通过 URL 收藏或分享给有权限的同事。
items.summary_en: GitHub Public Monitoring alerts for enterprises now support direct links to individual alerts. Users can open an alert from the enterprise Public Monitoring view and share or bookmark the alert URL for collaborators with access.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这不是能力边界上的突破，但改进了安全运营协作效率。对集中治理开源暴露面、泄露凭据与公共风险情报的组织来说，直接深链有助于工单、值班、审计与跨团队沟通。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is not a major capability shift, but it improves security operations collaboration. For organizations centralizing governance of public exposure, leaked secrets, and public risk intelligence, deep links make ticketing, on-call workflows, audits, and cross-team communication easier.
key_takeaways_zh: Public Monitoring 告警支持单条深链访问与分享。
主要价值在于提升企业安全协作与处置流转效率，而非新增检测能力。
key_takeaways_en: Public Monitoring alerts can now be opened and shared via direct links.
The main value is better enterprise security workflow coordination, not new detection coverage.
